answer.reason: Manoah's story in Judges 13 gives two chief events: his prayer for instruction about the promised child and his offering to the LORD, at which the angel ascended in the flame.

clauses.english: prayed that the man of God come again to teach them how to raise the promised child
clauses.quote: let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us

clauses.english: offered a kid on a rock to the LORD, and the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame
clauses.quote: the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar
